verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform that stores customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or hosting location. The API scopes and authentication items cover access control, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
